name: Find the Maximum Length of Valid Subsequence III
englishName: Find the Maximum Length of Valid Subsequence III
hints: 1a (Dynamic Programming): If the last element of a valid subsequence has remainder r modulo k, the next element must have remainder (k - r) % k.

1b (Dynamic Programming): Scan nums from left to right. Store the longest valid subsequence ending at each remainder. For the current remainder, extend the best subsequence ending at its complementary remainder, or start a new subsequence if none exists.
2a (Greedy): A valid subsequence uses only a pair of complementary remainders. If a remainder is its own complement, every occurrence of that remainder can be selected.

2b (Greedy): For a pair of different complementary remainders, ignore all other elements. The longest alternating subsequence takes one element from each consecutive run of equal remainders in the filtered sequence.
